integrity: The local cut-locus jump-density identity is prior work and is cited as such.
The new claim is the exact facet-sum aggregation for \(J_2\) and the unique fixed-area rectangular maximizer.
Independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact shape optimizer is proved only within the family of rectangular flat two-tori of fixed area.
The general facet-sum formula is two-dimensional; no higher-dimensional formula is asserted.
\(J_2\) is the squared \(L^2\) integral of the singular Hessian-density magnitude on the cut locus, not a norm of the full distributional Hessian.
title: Exact cut-locus Hessian jump energy on flat two-tori
